ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Review_Year__c)), OR( LEN(Review_Year__c) <> 4, NOT(REGEX(Review_Year__c, "[0-9]{4}")), VALUE(Review_Year__c) < 2020, VALUE(Review_Year__c) > 2100 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Review Year must be a 4-digit year between 2020 and 2100 (e.g., 2026)
